V.name: Will
V.description: What a person wants, how they make choices, and how firmly they stand behind those choices when other people are involved.

L.name: Logic
L.description: How a person reasons, forms views about how things are, and handles ideas, explanations and disagreement.

E.name: Emotion
E.description: How a person experiences, shows and responds to feelings and mood, their own and other people's.

F.name: Physics
F.description: The body in action, physical comfort, possessions, money, practical skill and the person's surroundings.
